name: The Mind

endCondition.description: Win by completing all levels (2p: 12, 3p: 10, 4p: 8); lose when the last life is lost

categories.label: Team won (completed all levels)
categories.labelVi: Cả đội thắng (qua hết các level)

winCondition: All players are one team; they win by completing every level in the stack and lose when the team's last life is gone. Blind mode continues afterwards for extra levels.
notes: family: coop. Start lives/throwing stars: 2p 2/1, 3p 3/1, 4p 4/1; level rewards at 2,3,5,6,8,9; max 5 lives and 3 stars. Blind mode: after winning, replay from level 1 with cards face down; score is levels completed blind (use levelsCompleted).
